name: Duck under
description: Ducking (D85): the track goes down by amountDb while a key track (under) has speech, from the key media's measured loudness envelope mapped through the timeline. Precomputed: the same gain curve in the preview and the export, no live sidechain. Needs the key media's loudness analysis (run automatically when missing).
author: Biliup

under.description: Key track ids: this track ducks while any of them has speech. An empty list ducks nothing.

amountDb.description: How far it goes down (dB). Used down to −40 (deeper values are clamped; v0.1 had no lower bound).

attackMs.description: Fade-down length (ms); it starts this long before the speech, so the duck is down when the speech starts.

releaseMs.description: Fade-up length (ms) after the speech ends.

thresholdDb.description: Key level (dBFS of the key media) that counts as speech; absent = automatic (the speech level less 25 dB, at least 10 dB over the noise floor).
